methodological_rigor.justification: In vitro AR-SENP5 axis study with limited experimental scope. SENP5 silencing and ChIP-qPCR for AR binding provided. Lacks comprehensive mechanistic characterization. No animal models. Statistical rigor not evident.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Preclinical mechanistic study. No animal models or clinical samples. Translational pathway unclear. Speculation about clinical significance.

reporting_quality.justification: Minimal methods detail. No data availability statement. Limited experimental documentation for reproducibility.

novelty_literature.justification: AR signaling in prostate cancer well-studied. SENP5 as downstream target novel but preliminary. Minimal mechanistic insight.

writing_presentation.justification: Very brief report. Lacks substantial discussion or mechanistic detail.

key_strengths: AR-SENP5 co-expression identified in prostate cancer
ChIP-qPCR demonstrates AR transcriptional regulation of SENP5
key_concerns: Extremely limited experimental scope; single mechanism (AR-SENP5 axis) without downstream effectors
Inconsistent with abstract claim of SENP5 negatively correlating with OS—mechanism not explained
Missing critical experiments on SENP5 function in androgen-responsive gene regulation
chief_reviewer.rationale: Preliminary mechanistic fragment insufficient for publication. Requires substantially expanded experimental work and in vivo validation.
